description.narrative: Not unlike its neighboring countries, Mali is subject to an increasingly recurring natural and humanitarian crisis. Over the past years the country recorded the following natural and humanitarian crisis; droughts, floods, cholera epidemics, and mass population movements related to social and armed conflicts (e.g. in northern and center regions).

Putting response analysis and planning tools & systems in place; the Mali Red Cross enhances their internal and external response coordination; the MRC improves operational response capacity; the MRC has response policy, strategy and standards in place; the MRC has a solid response operations support system; the MRC has Early Action Protocols that are developed based on impact-based forecast methodology.
Strengthening the emergency and natural disaster preparedness and response systems
